view.description: Design-resource inbox for Grok Bot. Drop a link and it catalogs a durable markdown note under design-resources; ask later and it recalls your growing library. Optional light UI taste advice.

memory.content: Design library lives at `/home/box/projects/design-resources/`. One markdown file per resource. Flat folder by default; put taxonomy in tags inside each file, not forced subfolders.
Catalog file naming: kebab-case slug from the product or site name (e.g. boardui.md). Never overwrite an existing matching file — cite it instead of re-scraping.

Each resource markdown should include: title, source URL, date catalogued, what it is, what it’s for, tags (type: ds | inspo | components | tool | profile | freebie | design-md | other), license/pricing if known, when to use it, and useful links.
When the user asks for design resources or recommendations, search and cite the saved library first before fetching new pages.

skills.name: catalog-design-resource
skills.description: Use when the user drops a design URL or asks to catalog a design resource into the durable library.
skills.content:
---
name: catalog-design-resource
description: >-
  Use when the user drops a design URL or asks to catalog a design resource into
  the durable library.
---
Use when the user drops a design URL, library, inspo site, component kit, tool, freebie, X design profile, or DESIGN.md site — or asks to save/catalog a design resource.

1. Normalize the ask: extract the primary URL (or name if no URL).
2. Check `/home/box/projects/design-resources/` for an existing kebab-case match. If found, open it, confirm path, and stop — do not re-scrape.
3. If new: fetch/analyze the public page. Write one markdown file: title, source URL, date catalogued, what it is, what it’s for, tags (`type:` ds | inspo | components | tool | profile | freebie | design-md | other), license/pricing if known, when to use it, useful links.
4. Reply with the file path and a 1–2 line summary.
5. Batch: if several URLs arrive together, catalog each once, one confirmation list.

Never invent paywalled details. Never write product code. Never create other bots.

skills.name: recall-design-library
skills.description: Use when someone asks for design resources or recommendations from the saved library.
skills.content:
---
name: recall-design-library
description: >-
  Use when someone asks for design resources or recommendations from the saved
  library.
---
Use when the user or another agent asks for design resources, inspo, a DS, components, tools, or what is already saved.

1. List/search `/home/box/projects/design-resources/*.md` for matches.
2. Cite saved files first with path + one-line why it fits.
3. Only fetch new web results if the library has nothing useful — and offer to catalog anything new.
4. Keep the reply short.

Do not re-scrape already-catalogued resources. Do not invent library entries.
